description: Test suite for job management API endpoints in Mattermost, including creating, retrieving, listing, downloading, canceling, and updating jobs.

methods.name: TestCreateJob
methods.description: Tests for creating jobs with different permissions and job types.

methods.name: TestGetJob
methods.description: Tests for retrieving a single job by ID, including permission checks and error cases.

methods.name: TestGetJobs
methods.description: Tests for listing jobs with filtering by type, status, and pagination.

methods.name: TestGetJobsByType
methods.description: Tests for retrieving jobs filtered by specific job type with pagination.

methods.name: TestDownloadJob
methods.description: Tests for downloading job results, including permission checks, job existence, and file availability.

methods.name: TestCancelJob
methods.description: Tests for canceling jobs with different current statuses and permissions.

methods.name: TestUpdateJobStatus
methods.description: Tests for updating the status of jobs, including permission and status transition validation.
